concept: A switch is a recess with a bead in it, lit from above. Off, the recess is shaded glass; on, the track is lit from within, bright in dark and ink in light, and the bead has rolled to the far end.

default_to_avoid.pattern: the iOS or Material toggle switch: a flat coloured capsule track with a white disc and a drop shadow
default_to_avoid.why_not: it is the toggle every app already has, drawn on top of the surface; on a pane it says nothing about glass, and the thin pale track measured 2.1:1 in the light theme (R-007)

derivation.consequence: legibility comes from dimming and blurring the backdrop (brightness, blur) inside a smoked body thick enough that a pane reads as a slab of glass, with the scene softened behind it
derivation.form: the track is a recess made by dimming, with shade under its top lip, light on its bottom lip and no opaque fill

derivation.consequence: the scene supplies the hue; the system owns no hue of its own, only white at opacities and one ink, and colour appears only where it states a status or marks a diagram
derivation.form: on lights the track from within, white glass in dark and ink in light, with a mark at its start

derivation.consequence: controls are full pills because they are held in the hand
derivation.form: the recess is a full pill and the knob a round bead, lit on its top

derivation.consequence: selected and pressed states change shape or add a mark (a check, a ring), never only colour
derivation.form: on adds a mark at the start of the track and the bead moves to the far end

derivation.consequence: a pressed control shrinks slightly, as something pushed
derivation.form: a press squashes the bead along the track, toward where it is about to go

variants.supersedes: A well in the pane (forms round, 2026-10-27)
variants.reason: A keeps D-020 (a well in the pane) and gives it depth: the recess is carved by its two lips (P1 depth) and the knob is a bead with its own light (P3). Its edge measured 3.0 to 4.8:1 in both themes. B adds a glow that no principle asks for and measured 2.7:1 off in light. C's capsule hides the on mark inside the knob, which reads as decoration.

description.why: the description is secondary text under the label, read after the control name

knob.why: a round bead lit on its top, sitting in the recess on a short shadow

label.why: the label looks like a label and also toggles the control, so the target is the whole line

root.why: the component owns the spacing between its own parts, so children never carry margins and rows line up

text.why: the label and description stack beside the control and share its 44px row

tick.why: a tick appears on the track when on, so the state has a mark as well as a colour

track.why: a recess carved into the surface by dimming, shaded under the top lip and lit on the bottom lip, with an edge that measures 3:1 in both themes

@media forced-colors: active.why: in forced colours the well becomes a system-colour border, so the field keeps its edge without glass

data-state=checked.why: on lights the track from within, bright in dark and ink in light, and spills a little light onto the pane; the bead rolls to the far end

disabled.why: disabled fades to the disabled opacity token and the reason is written beside it

focus-visible.why: keyboard focus draws the shared 2px ring with its halo, visible on any part of any scene

active.why: a press squashes the bead along the track toward where it is going, as something pushed

aria-invalid=true.why: a wrong answer takes the critical ring a field takes, and FormField says what is wrong in words

background-color.why: the track colour eases at the same pace as the knob, so colour and movement read as one event

opacity.why: the tick fades in at hover pace together with the knob

transform.why: press and travel move by transform over the soft curve, so nothing shifts the layout

box-shadow.why: the recess shading changes with its fill at hover pace so the two read as one event

inline-size.why: the squash on press runs at press pace, because a press is a reply

inset-inline-start.why: when on, the squash grows backward along the track at press pace so the bead stays against its end

options: C A with a spectral edge
round4.reason: The user rejected the blue and showed a reference where one light from above lights every atom alike. A reads that straight: the same top rim and sheen on every surface, the white lit solid for the loud action, chosen items as lighter glass. B makes chosen items recesses, which reads as pressed-off rather than chosen. C adds a rainbow edge, a hue the system no longer owns (P1).
